title: Time-of-Use Formulas in SAP and MDUS Systems

Time-of-Use Formulas in SAP and MDUS Systems

Use

Time-of-use formulas are used to aggregate consumption and demand from a profile. Formulas exist in the Meter Data Unification
and Synchronization system (MDUS system) and in the SAP system, but with the following distinction:

e MDUS system: Algorithm as well as input and output parameters

e SAP system: Only the information required for the time-of-use interface and the MDUS request. This is as follows:
o IDof formula in MDUS system
o Input parameters (quantity, demand, profiles, indicators) and output parameters (quantity, demand)

The first input parameter of a formula is always a profile. You cannot change these parameters. The actual profile
number is determined by the MDUS request and during billing.

Settings in the SAP System

You have to make settings for the SAP formulas in Customizing for Contract Billing under |»Billing Master Data's AMI: Time-of-
Use Interface

Time-of-Use Interface

Use

You use the time-of-use interface to aggregate profiles stored in a Meter Data Unification and Synchronization system (MDUS
system) for billing in the SAP system. The interface contains the periods (for example, a weekday in summer 08:00-17:59) and
time-of-use formulas (for example, consumption above limit value), which are used to aggregate the profile values for the MDUS
request and to transfer them to the rate for billing. The following figure uses an example to illustrate this:
